test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb, 2026 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
From the alternatives given below, select the correct meaning of the idiom.
King's ransom.

options.text: To demand something or some action from someone by threatening them with a harmful consequence if they do not comply
An opening speech at the Parliament

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **An exorbitant sum of money**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"King's ransom"** refers to an exorbitant or extremely large amount of money. (बहुत बड़ी राशि)
 
 
• **Example:** The painting was sold for a king's ransom at the auction.
 
 
• This idiom is used figuratively to describe something of immense monetary value or worth.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **An exorbitant sum of money**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** To demand something or some action from someone by threatening them with a harmful consequence if they do not comply. (धमकी देकर कुछ मांगना)
 
 
• **Example:** The kidnappers tried to extort money by threatening the victim's family.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** An opening speech at the Parliament. (संसद में उद्घाटन भाषण)
 
 
• **Example:** The Prime Minister delivered the opening speech at the budget session of Parliament.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** Budget session. (बजट सत्र)
 
 
• **Example:** The budget session is a crucial part of the annual parliamentary schedule.
 
 

21b:T710,

The correct answer is **option 1.**
